english.title: Authorised treatment facility fail to issue destruction certificate to last holder / owner of vehicle
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 27, 31(a) and 32 of the End-of-Life Vehicle Regulations 2003.

date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulations 28 of the End-of-Life Vehicle Regulations 2003 provides that no charge to be issued for a destruction certificate.
(ii) ) Regulations 29 of the End-of-Life Vehicle Regulations 2003 provides that no charge to be issued for the form and content of certificate.
